# Word coordinates from the GAPEKA 2025 register, pages 52, 55 and 58, as
# pdfplumber's extract_words() gives them: x0, top, text. One word a line.
#
# Pages 55 and 58 each print a stretch of one distance matrix as vertical text,
# so recover_vertical_codes() has to read four station codes out of a header
# that extract_text() returns interleaved with the index row. Where one header
# column ends and the next begins lives only in these x0, which is why this
# fixture exists alongside the page text in register_tables.txt. Page 52 is
# here as the ordinary case, a page with nothing wrecked on it.
#
# Every word on each page EXCEPT the printed distances, which no coordinate
# reading needs: a distance is "1.234,567" in the register's own formatting and
# none of it is a station code, an index or an O/D mark. Dropping them takes
# pages 52, 55 and 58 from 4,113 words to 929. Nothing else is filtered.
